members.lead: Police have taken MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Begum, into custody following the recovery of the hanging body of his second wife, Mosammat Mariam Khatun, 19, from the NAM Bhaban. members.title: MP Gazi Nazrul’s 2nd wife found hanging in NAM Bhaban
members.lead: Police recovered the hanging body of Mosa Mariam Khatun, 19, the second wife of Satkhira-4 MP GM Nazrul Islam, from the capital’s NAM Bhaban on Sunday night.Her body was recovered from Flat No 203 on the third floor of Building No 5 at the NAM Bhaban under Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station.Tejgaon Division Deputy Commissioner of Police Ibne Mizan confirmed the matter to the media.He said around 8:30pm that the body was still hanging when police reached the scene.
